title: HorsePort
description: Teleports a player's tamed horse with them when using teleport commands such as /home and /rtp.
body:
# HorsePortPlugin

HorsePortPlugin is a lightweight Paper plugin that automatically teleports a player's tamed horse alongside them when they use common teleport commands.

Many servers allow players to travel using commands such as `/home`, `/rtp`, and other plugin-based teleports. Unfortunately, horses are often left behind when these teleports occur. HorsePortPlugin solves this problem by ensuring a player's owned horse is moved to the same destination, allowing riders and their mounts to stay together.

## Features

* Automatically teleports player-owned horses
* Works with common teleport commands
* Prevents horses from being left behind
* Lightweight and efficient
* No configuration required
* Server-side only
* Minecraft 1.21+ support

## Installation

1. Download the latest version of HorsePortPlugin.
2. Place the JAR file into your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Restart your server.

## Compatibility

* Paper 1.21+
* Compatible with most plugins that use standard player teleport events

## Permissions

No permissions are required.

## Configuration

No configuration is required. Install the plugin and it will begin working automatically.

## Why Use HorsePortPlugin?

Travelling around a server with a horse can be frustrating when teleport commands leave your mount behind. HorsePortPlugin provides a simple solution by keeping players and their horses together, making travel more convenient and improving the overall gameplay experience.
